title: porch extension pi output (schema 1)
description: What a caller passes to Pi to attach Porch's extension to one session: the arguments, and the environment the extension reads its records folder from.

extension.description: Absolute path of Porch's built Pi extension.

porchHome.description: The --porch-home given, as an absolute path, or null.

args.description: Pi arguments that load the extension for one session: ["-e", <extension>].

env.description: Variables to set in Pi's environment: PORCH_HOME when --porch-home was given, otherwise empty.
